description_en: This API is used to obtain the list of publishing users in a communication session based on the subscriber
description_zh: 本接口用于根据订阅端获取通信中发布端用户列表
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-pub-user-list-by-sub-user --app-id testappid --channel-id testid --created-ts 1614936817 --sub-user-id testuserid --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePubUserListBySubUser

parameters.help_en: The channel creation time. You can query data from the last 30 days. The value is represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 频道创建时间，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: created_ts

parameters.help_en:
The channel release time, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If this parameter is empty, the current time is used.  
If the provided channel release time exceeds the actual release time, data from the creation time to the actual release time will be returned
parameters.help_zh:
频道释放时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据
parameters.name: destroyed_ts

IN：进行中。

CallStatus.title_zh: 通信状态。取值：IN：进行中。OUT：已结束。

CallIdList.description_en: Call IDs of the user's communication streams.

items.description_en:
Call ID of the user's communication stream.  

This field is returned when a subscriber has subscribed to downstream data but the corresponding upstream data from the publisher is missing. In this case, other fields of the object in PubUserDetailList (such as UserId and Roles) are not returned.
items.description_zh:
用户通信流的Call ID。

当订阅端有订阅的下行数据并且对应发布端的上行数据缺失时返回该字段，同时，PubUserDetailList中对象的其他字段（例如UserId、Roles等）不会返回
